cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

# Execute system commands to gather network information
execute_process(
    COMMAND arp -a
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE ARP_OUTPUT
    ERROR_VARIABLE ARP_ERROR
    RESULT_VARIABLE ARP_RESULT
)

execute_process(
    COMMAND ifconfig
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE IFCONFIG_OUTPUT
    ERROR_VARIABLE IFCONFIG_ERROR
    RESULT_VARIABLE IFCONFIG_RESULT
)

# Display the results
message(STATUS "ARP Table:")
if(ARP_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(STATUS "${ARP_OUTPUT}")
else()
    message(WARNING "Failed to execute 'arp -a': ${ARP_ERROR}")
endif()

message(STATUS "Network Interface Configuration:")
if(IFCONFIG_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(STATUS "${IFCONFIG_OUTPUT}")
else()
    message(WARNING "Failed to execute 'ifconfig': ${IFCONFIG_ERROR}")
endif()

# Set project name
project(NetworkInfo C)

# Add a custom target to run these commands
add_custom_target(network_info
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "Gathering network information..."
    COMMAND arp -a
    COMMAND ifconfig
    COMMENT "Executing network diagnostic commands"
)

message(STATUS "CMake configuration complete. Use 'make network_info' to run the diagnostic commands.")
